title: FamilyModel
description: The family's values and goals for the child (blueprint: Family Model — values/goals/observations, never 'control'). Parent goals reach the child ONLY via the interest bridge: goal + child interest → adventure theme (e.g. English goal + loves animals → '豆豆兔动物园管理员'). Priority order: safety > child autonomy > growth goals > parent expectations.

values.description: Family-stated values (zh), e.g. '户外运动优先'.

translated_theme.description: Interest-bridge output: the adventure theme this goal was translated into (zh). Empty until bridged.

constraints.description: Hard family rules (zh), e.g. '每次不超过10分钟'. Highest priority after safety.
